snippet.title: Monstro Maestro – Official Trailer [EN] | Game Academy 2025 Student Game
snippet.description:
🎬 Monstro Maestro – Official Trailer 🎶

Dive into a haunted mansion as wacky as it is dangerous, and play as a conductor ready to do anything to reunite your band!
Possessed by a jealous ghost, your musicians are scattered throughout the estate. It's up to you to find them, overcome rhythmic challenges, and prove your band deserves the stage.

👻 A game developed by second-year students at Game Academy as their final-year project.

🔔 Subscribe to discover more original creations!
